_doc: Plain names for the bench's main dials (tools/sim/bench.py). Every other settable number is still listed in the bench under its game name. 'help' says what the number is; what it moves is measured, not written here (bench_scan.py -> bench_effects.json).

model.CULTIVATION_YIELD.label: Food one field worker grows in a day
model.CULTIVATION_YIELD.help: Rations from the fields for each worker-day, before soil, seed and season.

c.yield_calibration.label: Wild food yield
c.yield_calibration.help: Multiplier on what gathering, hunting and fishing bring in.

p.harvest_mult.label: All harvests (multiplier)
p.harvest_mult.help: One multiplier on every source of food. 1.1 is the fitted value.

model.HARVEST_SETTLED.label: Harvests after the founding years
model.HARVEST_SETTLED.help: The founding yields settle to this share of themselves (0.77 = 23% lower).

model.HARVEST_SETTLED_YEAR.label: Year the harvests finish settling
model.HARVEST_SETTLED_YEAR.help: The year by which the founding yields have fully settled.

c.spoilage_fresh.label: Fresh food spoiling each day
c.spoilage_fresh.help: Share of the fresh food lost every day.

c.spoilage_stored.label: Stored food spoiling each day
c.spoilage_stored.help: Share of the stored food lost every day.

model.FOOD_CARE.LEAN_DAYS.label: Days of food that count as enough
model.FOOD_CARE.LEAN_DAYS.help: Stores at this many days read as fully secure; fewer starts to hurt.

model.RULER.RESERVE_TARGET_DAYS.label: Days of food the leaders aim to hold
model.RULER.RESERVE_TARGET_DAYS.help: The reserve the leaders plan the food work toward.

p.food_buffer.label: Food work held above bare need
p.food_buffer.help: How far above the day's need the leaders plan the food work (fitted).

model.FOOD_FLOOR_OF_TYPICAL.label: Least food work the leaders allow
model.FOOD_FLOOR_OF_TYPICAL.help: Share of the age's typical food work the leaders never go below.

model.PREMODERN_FECUNDITY.label: Births before modern times (multiplier)
model.PREMODERN_FECUNDITY.help: Multiplier on how often women conceive in the early ages.

p.other_mortality.label: Everyday deaths
p.other_mortality.help: Deaths a year from accidents, thirst and other causes not modelled one by one (share of the people).

p.disease_pressure.label: Sickness in this land
p.disease_pressure.help: How sickly the home land is (0 to 1).

p.cold_pressure.label: Cold in this land
p.cold_pressure.help: How hard the cold is on the people (0 to 1).

model.CROWDING_ONSET.label: Crowding starts at
model.CROWDING_ONSET.help: Share of what the land can hold at which crowding begins to bite.

model.SPARE_LAND_CONCEPTION.label: Extra births on empty land
model.SPARE_LAND_CONCEPTION.help: How strongly spare land raises births.

model.FRONTIER_CONCEPTION.label: Extra births on the frontier
model.FRONTIER_CONCEPTION.help: Births raised while the people are well under what the land holds.

model.INFANT_LOSS_REPLACEMENT.label: Births that follow a lost baby
model.INFANT_LOSS_REPLACEMENT.help: How strongly families have another child after losing one.

model.CARER_CROWDING.label: How much carers ease crowding
model.CARER_CROWDING.help: Share of crowding's harm that full care takes away.

p.tune_burden_scale.label: Early ages' burden on mothers and babies
p.tune_burden_scale.help: Multiplier on the extra burden of the early ages (1 = the game as it is).

p.tune_research_pace.label: Learning speed (multiplier)
p.tune_research_pace.help: Multiplier on the daily progress on every question (1 = the game as it is).

p.tune_adoption_pace.label: How fast households take up what is learned
p.tune_adoption_pace.help: Multiplier on the spread of a discovery through the people.

p.tune_cap_scale.label: How much each age's knowledge can give
p.tune_cap_scale.help: Multiplier on the ceiling an age puts on the payoff of knowledge.

model.LEARNING_CAP.balanced.label: Most workers on learning: balanced path
model.LEARNING_CAP.balanced.help: Share of the people at work the balanced path will put on learning.

model.LEARNING_CAP.learning.label: Most workers on learning: learning path
model.LEARNING_CAP.learning.help: Share of the people at work the learning path will put on learning.

model.LEARNERS_KEPT.label: Learners the leaders always keep
model.LEARNERS_KEPT.help: Share of the people at work kept on learning whatever else is pressing.

model.QUESTION_EXPONENT.label: What each added learner is worth
model.QUESTION_EXPONENT.help: A team of n learners does n to this power of work (1 = every learner counts in full).

model.FOUNDING.FOUNDING_WORK.label: Extra work of the founding years' questions
model.FOUNDING.FOUNDING_WORK.help: A young people's questions ask this many times the work, fading by year 30.

c.era_doubling.label: Years ahead that double a question's work
c.era_doubling.help: Past the age's window, a question costs double for every this many years it lies ahead.

model.NORMAL.LEAD_YEARS_PER_DOUBLING.label: Lead gained by doubling the learners
model.NORMAL.LEAD_YEARS_PER_DOUBLING.help: Years a year a people pulls ahead of its age for each doubling of its learners.

model.LEARNER_GOODS.LEARNER_DAYS_PER_GOO.label: Learner-days one good lasts
model.LEARNER_GOODS.LEARNER_DAYS_PER_GOO.help: Learners use up one unit of goods for this many days of study.

model.GOODS_K.BASE_RATE.label: Goods one maker makes
model.GOODS_K.BASE_RATE.help: The makers' base rate, before technique and specialization.

model.GOODS_K.DAILY_WEAR.label: Goods wearing out each day
model.GOODS_K.DAILY_WEAR.help: Share of the goods in use lost to wear every day.

model.GOODS_K.BASE_TARGET_PER_PERSON.label: Goods each person needs
model.GOODS_K.BASE_TARGET_PER_PERSON.help: What a household wants a head at the start; knowledge adds to it.

model.GOODS_X.SURPLUS_PER_HEAD.label: Goods made for barter, a head
model.GOODS_X.SURPLUS_PER_HEAD.help: How much past the homes' need the makers will make to trade.

model.GOODS_X.RAW_PER_UNIT.label: Materials used for one good
model.GOODS_X.RAW_PER_UNIT.help: Loads of raw materials one unit of goods takes.

model.BASKET_YIELD.label: Materials one cutter brings in a day
model.BASKET_YIELD.help: Loads a day from one person cutting and digging, at base.

model.GOODS_X.SPECIALIZATION.label: Gain from many makers working together
model.GOODS_X.SPECIALIZATION.help: How much more each maker makes when a large share of the people make.

model.WATCH_FREE_SHARE.label: Watch the people keep at no cost
model.WATCH_FREE_SHARE.help: Share of the people who can stand watch before it costs births and health.

model.WATCH_UPKEEP.label: Cost of a larger watch
model.WATCH_UPKEEP.help: Multiplier on what a watch past the free one costs the people.

model.GUARD.GUARD_SHARE.label: Guard each town keeps
model.GUARD.GUARD_SHARE.help: A town needs this share of its people on guard (and never fewer than its least guard).

model.ARMS_SHARE.label: Makers' work given to arms
model.ARMS_SHARE.help: Share of the making that goes to arms while the watch lacks them.

model.WATCH.START_DRILL.label: Drill of a fresh watch
model.WATCH.START_DRILL.help: How drilled the watch is on its first day (0 to 1).

model.WATCH.MARTIAL_DRILL.label: Extra drill of a people given to war
model.WATCH.MARTIAL_DRILL.help: Added to the drill a war-minded people can reach.

model.WARRIOR_WEIGHT.label: What a drilled fighter counts for
model.WARRIOR_WEIGHT.help: A trained, ready warrior counts as this many untrained defenders.

model.TERRITORY_SLOPE.label: Land each new town adds
model.TERRITORY_SLOPE.help: Each town past the first adds this much of the home land (times the square root of the towns).

model.SITE_YEARS.label: Years between new town sites
model.SITE_YEARS.help: One more good site is known every this many years.

model.LAND.RISE_YEAR.label: How fast surveying opens the land
model.LAND.RISE_YEAR.help: Share of the land's yield a full crew of surveyors opens in a year.

model.LAND.YIELD_SPAN.label: What well-surveyed land adds
model.LAND.YIELD_SPAN.help: Yield gained between unsurveyed and fully surveyed land.

model.LAND.PEOPLE_PER_SEARCHER.label: People one surveyor can serve
model.LAND.PEOPLE_PER_SEARCHER.help: A people needs one surveyor for each this many people.

p.found_interval_years.label: Years between a crowded people's new towns
p.found_interval_years.help: Without leaders founding towns: at most one new town in this many years, once crowded.

p.found_from_year.label: First year a crowded people founds a town
p.found_from_year.help: Without leaders founding towns: no new towns before this year.

crisis.BASE_SICKNESS.label: How often sickness breaks out
crisis.BASE_SICKNESS.help: Outbreaks a game year at the reference state, before crowding, health and water.

crisis.BASE_FIRE.label: How often fire breaks out
crisis.BASE_FIRE.help: Fires a game year at the reference state, before crowding.

crisis.BASE_FLOOD_WET.label: How often it floods in a wet year
crisis.BASE_FLOOD_WET.help: Floods a game year at the reference state when the year is wet.

crisis.QUIET_AFTER_FOUNDING.label: Quiet days after the founding
crisis.QUIET_AFTER_FOUNDING.help: No crisis begins before this many days.

crisis.ONSET_GAP.label: Fewest days between crises
crisis.ONSET_GAP.help: A new crisis waits at least this long after the last began.

crisis.FLOOR_SHARE.label: A crisis never takes the people below
crisis.FLOOR_SHARE.help: Share of the people a single crisis leaves alive at the least.

p.housing_build_rate.label: Homes one builder raises
p.housing_build_rate.help: Housing places from one builder's day (fitted).

p.housing_target_ratio.label: Homes kept ahead of the people
p.housing_target_ratio.help: The leaders build until there are this many places for each person.

model.BUILD_DRAW.label: Materials a builder uses a day
model.BUILD_DRAW.help: Loads of raw materials each builder draws a day (a stand-in, not a game number).

fabric.WORKS_LOADS.label: Materials a day of work-building takes
fabric.WORKS_LOADS.help: Loads of timber, clay or stone one builder-day on work buildings uses.
